understeer.name: Understeer (Car not turning enough)
understeer.description: The front tires lose grip before the rears, causing the car to push wide in corners. The car doesn't respond to steering input as much as you want.

adjustments.reason: Increases front downforce and front-end grip
Reduces rear downforce to shift balance forward
Allows more rotation on corner entry
Softer front suspension increases mechanical grip
Reduces stiffness for more front grip
More negative camber improves cornering grip

understeer.explanation_template: To fix understeer, we need to add more front grip or reduce rear grip. I've increased the front wing by {fw_change} to give you more front downforce. I've also {other_changes}. This should help the car turn in better.

oversteer.name: Oversteer (Rear sliding out)
oversteer.description: The rear tires lose grip before the fronts, causing the back end to slide out. The car feels nervous and twitchy, especially on corner exit.

adjustments.reason: Increases rear downforce and stability
Reduces front grip to balance the car
Locks rear wheels more for better traction
Softer rear gives more mechanical grip
Reduces stiffness for more rear traction
Less negative camber improves exit traction

oversteer.explanation_template: To fix oversteer, we need more rear stability. I've increased the rear wing by {rw_change} for more rear downforce. I've also {other_changes}. This should stabilize the rear end.

tire_overheating.name: Tire Overheating
tire_overheating.description: Tires getting too hot and losing grip. Can cause both understeer and oversteer depending on which tires overheat.

adjustments.reason: Higher pressure reduces tire temperature
Higher pressure reduces tire temperature
Less negative camber reduces tire stress
Less negative camber reduces tire stress
Less downforce means less tire load and heat
Less downforce means less tire load and heat

tire_overheating.explanation_template: Your tires are overheating. I've increased tire pressures by {pressure_change} PSI to help cool them down. I've also {other_changes}. Try to be smoother with steering and throttle inputs.

tire_wear.name: Excessive Tire Wear
tire_wear.description: Tires degrading too quickly over a race stint.

adjustments.reason: Reduces tire contact patch and wear rate
Reduces tire contact patch and wear rate
Less aggressive camber reduces wear
Less aggressive camber reduces wear
Less toe reduces scrubbing and wear

tire_wear.explanation_template: To reduce tire wear, I've increased tire pressures and made the geometry less aggressive. This will extend tire life but you might lose a bit of peak grip. Drive smoothly to maximize tire life.

poor_balance.name: Poor Balance (Car feeling unstable)
poor_balance.description: Car doesn't feel planted or predictable. Can be a combination of understeer and oversteer at different parts of the corner.

adjustments.reason: More stability on power
More stability on entry
Stiffer front for more responsiveness
Stiffer rear for more control
Reduces body roll
Reduces body roll

poor_balance.explanation_template: To improve overall balance, I've made the car more stable by adjusting the differential and stiffening the suspension slightly. The car should feel more predictable now.

bottoming_out.name: Bottoming Out (Car hitting the ground)
bottoming_out.description: Car's floor hitting the track surface over bumps or at high speed, causing loss of control and damage.

adjustments.reason: Raises front of car to prevent contact
Raises rear of car to prevent contact
Stiffer suspension resists bottoming
Stiffer suspension resists bottoming

bottoming_out.explanation_template: You're bottoming out. I've raised the ride height by {rh_change}mm and stiffened the suspension. You'll lose a bit of downforce but the car will be more stable over bumps.

brake_locking.name: Brake Locking (Wheels locking under braking)
brake_locking.description: Wheels lock up under braking, causing flat spots and loss of control.

adjustments.reason: Reduces overall braking force
Shifts bias away from locking end
adjustments.note: If front locks, reduce bias. If rear locks, increase bias.

brake_locking.explanation_template: To prevent brake locking, I've reduced brake pressure by {pressure_change}% and adjusted brake bias. You'll need to brake a bit earlier but with more control.
